---
title: Introduction
---

The `ambdes` model has been developed as a pilot/prototype/test of creating a open-source DES model to support modelling demand etc., 

some context... The model of the ambulance system represents incidents across four response categories:

* C1 - life-threatening incidents
* C2 - emergency incidents
* C3 - urgent incidents
* C4 - less urgent incidents

The primary output is category 2 mean response time, and resource utilisation is a secondary output.
